市府维护的 Laguna de Santa Rosa 湿地保护空间，可用短步行观: City-maintained wetland space along the Laguna de Santa Rosa for short walks and seasonal observations. Check open paths and standing water. 市区西侧的盐沼、海岸与低丘，适合骑行、散步和观察水鸟，园内道路与步道可按距离折返: Marsh, shoreline and low hills west of town offer cycling, walking and waterbird observation, with routes that can be shortened by turning back. Vehicle entry is charged and dogs must be leashed; birding and bay views do not imply safe swimming.
